age: Integer

employment_score : Float

education_score : Float
    
marital-status : Categorical
                Married  
                Single    
                Divorced 

sex : Categorical
    Male
    Female

cap_gain : Float

cap_loss : Float

race : Binary
    1 : White
    0 : others (black, hispanic etc)
    
income : binary target
        0 : <=50K
        1 : >50K.
